newsitem.title: USA: U.S. soybean weekly export sales highlights--USDA.
newsitem.headline: U.S. soybean weekly export sales highlights--USDA.

text.p: USDA soybean export sales highlights in latest reporting week:
Net sales of 17,800 MT were 93 percent more than the prior week and 8 percent above the 4-week average.
Major increases for Taiwan (27,000 MT), Mexico (12,800 MT), and Israel (8,800 MT) were partially offset by reductions for Malaysia (25,000 MT, switched to optional origin) and Japan (13,300 MT).
Net sales of 133,400 MT for delivery during the 1997/98 marketing year were primarily for unknown destinations (104,000 MT).
Exports of 227,900 MT were off 13 percent from the previous week, but equaled the 4-week average.
The primary destinations were Japan (78,100 MT), Mexico (46,500 MT), Taiwan (27,000 MT), and Israel (26,500 MT).
